summary: Frontend-only regression after major rebrand to light premium theme + multi-page split. Verified all 6 public pages (Home, Recipes, Blog, Markets, Breakfast, Feedback) render correctly with the new burgundy-on-cream palette, no leftover dark backgrounds, no console/runtime errors. Recipes.benefits string normalisation working (12 cards render). Newsletter submission to /api/newsletter/subscribe returns 200 from Home and from Breakfast with interest='nigerian_breakfast' confirmed. Feedback page applied to new light theme with QR code visible. All 6 navbar links navigate correctly, logo returns to /, mobile menu toggles at <1024px. Shop section shows the 3 product cards (Metabo Ignite, Bloom & Flush, Glucose Guard). Footer present on all pages with Company No. 17024055.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar/Footer LOGO_URL is hard-coded in both components — could be imported from /app/frontend/src/assets/images.js (IMG.logo) for single source of truth.
App.js ScrollManager uses 'instant' in window check that always evaluates true — minor, doesn't affect behaviour.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth flow on public pages
seed_data_creation: Two newsletter subscriptions created via UI (test_newsletter_*@test.com from Home, test_breakfast@test.com with interest=nigerian_breakfast from Breakfast).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-page rebrand verified end-to-end. Routes /, /recipes, /blog, /markets, /breakfast, /feedback all render cleanly with light cream (#FAF5EE) background and burgundy (#6B1D3A) accents. ScrollManager scrolls to top on route change and handles /#shop /#about anchors. Navbar exposes data-testids: main-nav, nav-logo-link, header-logo, nav-shop, nav-recipes, nav-markets, nav-breakfast, nav-blog, nav-about, shop-now-btn, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu. Footer has data-testid='footer'. Recipes API benefits-as-string normalisation working — no slice/map runtime error. Breakfast signup form posts {email, interest:'nigerian_breakfast'} to /api/newsletter/subscribe and returns 200. AVIF assets loading from customer-assets.emergentagent.com. No console errors detected on any page during this iteration.
